title: rubus microphyllus subsp. koehneanus
intro: Rubus microphyllus subsp. koehneanus, commonly known as the Korean black raspberry or Chinese black raspberry, is a subspecies of the Rubus microphyllus plant. This plant is a type of bramble that is native to East Asia, known for its dark purple berries and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rubus microphyllus subsp. koehneanus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and other polyphenolic compounds that have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-oxidation, anti-cancer, and anti-aging properties.
